Dawi is medical clinics established to provide the Egyptian family with comprehensive medical service and health programs through international standards in the healthcare.

In order to meet the needs of the Egyptian family in full comfort, we provide medical services in the clinics of Dawi 24 hours / 7 weeks and even on official holidays.
